jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About Teads 

Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform building the future of digital advertising where quality content, trusted publishers, ambitious brands, and human creativity can thrive. Operating at true scale - processing 18 billion ad opportunities every single day - we connect global brands with a monthly reach of over 2.2 billion unique users.

At Teads, we believe your impact travels further. We are a borderless team of 1,700+ innovators across 30+ countries who favor outcome over tenure, value trusted autonomy, and use predictive AI to amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it. We move at pace, tackle genuinely complex problems, and foster a high-accountability culture that stays genuinely human. If you are looking for room to build and meaningful scope, you belong here. Learn more at www.teads.com.

About the opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join a team of passionate engineers who build premium solutions at scale. Every day, we tackle ambiguous and stimulating challenges. We build and operate large-scale distributed machine learning systems that process 1B predictions per second during real-time auctions.
